title_en: Impressions of Countries Around the World
note_en: 至于 introduces a new topic by contrast with what came before, like English "as for": 至于美国，很多人觉得… "As for the United States, many people feel…" It goes at the very start of the sentence, followed by the new topic, and then the comment. The text also uses 说起/提到/说到 ("speaking of," "when it comes to") to switch topics; 至于 is the one that signals "now for something different."
